brands.name: Tissot
brands.description: Tissot combines Swiss watchmaking with everyday practicality. Explore the angular PRX, the versatile Gentleman and the water-ready Seastar.
brands.summary: Swiss mechanical and quartz watches, from integrated bracelets to diving instruments.

brands.name: Grand Seiko
brands.description: Grand Seiko brings together mechanical and Spring Drive watchmaking. Its Heritage and Elegance collections pair distinctive dial textures with restrained proportions.
brands.summary: Japanese precision, textured dials and carefully finished cases.

brands.name: Seiko
brands.description: Discover Seiko through the dress-focused Presage, robust Prospex divers and versatile Seiko 5 Sports collection.
brands.summary: Accessible Japanese watchmaking for everyday wear, travel and diving.

collections.name: PRX
collections.description: An integrated bracelet and an angular case define this everyday collection.

collections.name: Gentleman
collections.description: A versatile round watch with a restrained dial and automatic movement.

collections.name: Seastar 1000
collections.description: Water-ready watches with rotating bezels and strong water resistance.

collections.name: Heritage
collections.description: Textured dials and carefully finished cases inspired by Japanese landscapes.

collections.name: Elegance
collections.description: Compact proportions, leather straps and classical dial layouts.

collections.name: Presage

collections.name: Prospex
